plain_description: DeepSeek-R1 delivers OpenAI-o1-class reasoning performance in math, code, and logic tasks — now open-source and MIT-licensed. It uses reinforcement learning to teach models to think step-by-step, and distilled versions run on hardware as small as 1.5B parameters. The bottom line: production-grade reasoning without the proprietary price tag.
technical_description: DeepSeek-R1 is a first-generation reasoning LLM trained via large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) on a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) base model (DeepSeek-V3-Base, 671B total / 37B activated parameters, 128K context). The pipeline alternates two RL stages (reasoning-pattern discovery and human-preference alignment) with two SFT stages (seed data for reasoning and non-reasoning capabilities). The model exposes an OpenAI-compatible REST API at platform.deepseek.com and a chat UI at chat.deepseek.com. Distilled dense variants (1.5B–70B) based on Qwen2.5 and Llama-3 are provided for local inference via vLLM or SGLang. Recommended temperature is 0.5–0.7; system prompts should be avoided.
title: DeepSeek-R1
